# HiCloudCam
> HiCloudCam provides cloud-connected IP camera apps, device access, and support resources for remote video monitoring.

HiCloudCam appears to offer mobile apps and cloud services for viewing, managing, and supporting connected cameras and related smart monitoring devices.

## Main Site
- [Home](https://www.hicloudcam.com/): Main entry point for HiCloudCam products, apps, and service information.
- [About](https://www.hicloudcam.com/about): Overview of the company and HiCloudCam platform background.
- [Contact](https://www.hicloudcam.com/contact): Contact information and support inquiry options for HiCloudCam users.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.hicloudcam.com/privacy): Privacy practices for the HiCloudCam website, apps, and services.
- [Terms of Service](https://www.hicloudcam.com/terms): Terms governing use of HiCloudCam services and related applications.

## Downloads
- [Download Center](https://www.hicloudcam.com/download): Central page for obtaining HiCloudCam apps and software.
- [iOS App](https://www.hicloudcam.com/download/ios): Download information for the HiCloudCam iPhone application.
- [Android App](https://www.hicloudcam.com/download/android): Download information for the HiCloudCam Android application.
- [PC Client](https://www.hicloudcam.com/download/windows): Windows desktop software for viewing and managing cameras.
- [Mac Client](https://www.hicloudcam.com/download/mac): macOS desktop software for accessing HiCloudCam devices.

## User Guides
- [Help Center](https://www.hicloudcam.com/help): General help resources for setup, usage, and troubleshooting.
- [Quick Start Guide](https://www.hicloudcam.com/help/quick-start): Basic steps to connect and begin using a HiCloudCam device.
- [Device Setup](https://www.hicloudcam.com/help/device-setup): Instructions for pairing cameras and configuring network connectivity.
- [Account Management](https://www.hicloudcam.com/help/account): Guidance for registration, login, and account settings.
- [Cloud Storage Guide](https://www.hicloudcam.com/help/cloud-storage): Information on cloud recording, playback, and subscription usage.
- [Troubleshooting](https://www.hicloudcam.com/help/troubleshooting): Common issues and fixes for connectivity, playback, and notifications.

## FAQ
- [FAQ Overview](https://www.hicloudcam.com/faq): Frequently asked questions about HiCloudCam services and devices.
- [Connection Issues](https://www.hicloudcam.com/faq/connection): Answers for camera offline and network connection problems.
- [Playback Issues](https://www.hicloudcam.com/faq/playback): Help for video playback, recording access, and timeline problems.
- [Notifications](https://www.hicloudcam.com/faq/notifications): Guidance for motion alerts and push notification behavior.
- [Subscription Questions](https://www.hicloudcam.com/faq/subscription): Billing and plan questions for cloud service subscriptions.

## Cloud Services
- [Cloud Service Overview](https://www.hicloudcam.com/cloud): Overview of HiCloudCam cloud recording and remote access features.
- [Plans & Pricing](https://www.hicloudcam.com/cloud/pricing): Subscription options and pricing for cloud storage services.
- [Cloud Playback](https://www.hicloudcam.com/cloud/playback): Information about reviewing recorded cloud video footage.
- [Event Recording](https://www.hicloudcam.com/cloud/events): Details on motion-triggered recordings and event history.
- [Subscription Management](https://www.hicloudcam.com/cloud/subscription): Manage active cloud plans and renewal settings.

## Support
- [Support Center](https://www.hicloudcam.com/support): Central support portal for product and service assistance.
- [Submit a Ticket](https://www.hicloudcam.com/support/ticket): Contact support for technical issues and account-related problems.
- [Firmware Support](https://www.hicloudcam.com/support/firmware): Firmware-related help and update guidance for supported devices.
- [Warranty Information](https://www.hicloudcam.com/support/warranty): Warranty terms and service coverage information for devices.
- [After-Sales Service](https://www.hicloudcam.com/support/after-sales): Post-purchase support policies and service procedures.
